commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.
90+4' Luis Milla (Getafe) takes a direct free kick.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
88' A substitution has been made. Ramon Terrats goes off and Allan Nyom (Getafe) comes on.
87' A clever short pass gives Ante Budimir (Osasuna) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball high over the bar.
86' Bryan Zaragoza (Osasuna) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.

86' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) runs onto the ball inside the box and smashes it towards the left side of the goal. It's a great effort but an even better save from David Soria, who tips the ball around the post.
85' Jose Bordalas Jimenez has decided to make a change. Juan Berrocal Gonzalez (Getafe) replaces Omar Alderete.
85' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Juan Bernat (Getafe) will replace Juanmi.
84' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Aimar Oroz (Osasuna).
83' The attendance for today's match is 19611.
83' David Soria makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded by Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) after a cross from the side.
80' Substitution. Jose Manuel Arnaiz (Osasuna) in, Jon Moncayola out.
79' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!

77' Alejandro Hernandez blows his whistle and Christantus Uche (Getafe) is shown a second yellow card for his foul. His manager will not be pleased. He has lot of time to think about it as he walks off.
76' Christantus Uche (Getafe) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
76' Great teamplay by Osasuna as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
73' Vicente Moreno decides to make a substitution. Ruben Garcia will be replaced by Raul Garcia (Osasuna).
71' 1 - 2 Goal! Ramon Terrats (Getafe) unleashes a first-time shot from inside the box and beats the goalkeeper into the bottom left corner. 1:2.
67' The game is interrupted as Jesus Areso (Osasuna) is flagged offside.
65' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) reacts well near the penalty spot to connect with the resulting corner, but fails to direct his header into the back of the net. The ball goes well wide of the left post.
65' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) prepares to take a corner kick.
64' Bryan Zaragoza (Osasuna) had a great opportunity from mid-range. His powerful volley was directed towards the left side of the goal, but David Soria was alert and made an astonishing save!
64' Bryan Zaragoza (Osasuna) works the corner short.
64' Bryan Zaragoza (Osasuna) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
61' Here comes a substitution. Pablo Ibanez is given a rest as he is replaced by Aimar Oroz (Osasuna).
61' Here is a change. Juan Cruz is going off and Vicente Moreno gives the last tactical orders to Abel Bretones (Osasuna).
57' Juanmi (Getafe) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Sergio Herrera comes off the line to clear the ball away.
57' Alejandro Hernandez blows his whistle for a foul after Ante Budimir (Osasuna) hacks down one of his opponents.
55' 1 - 1 Ramon Terrats (Getafe) receives a great pass from his teammate and strikes a very powerful shot towards goal that goes inside of the right post!
53' Bryan Zaragoza (Osasuna) shows his incredible technical ability by sending the ball into free space and Ruben Garcia latches onto his pass.
50' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Getafe.
46' Half-time substitution. Coba Gomez da Costa will not participate anymore and Borja Mayoral (Getafe) is coming on.
46' Half-time substitution. Jose Bordalas Jimenez decided to make a change. Djene is replaced by Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe).
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' 1 - 0 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Ante Budimir (Osasuna) low into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper David Soria no chance!
44' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
44' Domingos Duarte (Getafe) has tested the patience of referee Alejandro Hernandez and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
44' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Osasuna!

44' Play continues despite the shouts by some Osasuna players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Alejandro Hernandez interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
41' The corner is swung in but Getafe can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
37' Luis Milla (Getafe) extricates himself from the difficult situation with a good pass, comfortably eluding the pressing opponent.
36' Bryan Zaragoza (Osasuna) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
34' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Alejandro Hernandez had an easy-decision to make.
31' Alejandro Hernandez blows the whistle, Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) is penalised for a foul.
29' The whistle is blown for an infringement and Djene (Getafe) receives a yellow card!
27' A pass from Juanmi (Getafe) is intercepted by Sergio Herrera and the move breaks down.
25' Neat passing move from Getafe in order to create new attacking opportunities.
19' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) receives a pass and unleashes a shot which goes well wide of the right post.
18' Alejandro Hernandez couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Christantus Uche (Getafe) and blew his whistle.
15' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Jesus Areso (Osasuna) was quite harsh and Alejandro Hernandez didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
14' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
10' Bryan Zaragoza (Osasuna) sends a cross into the box, but David Soria comes off his line to gather the ball.
8' Getafe seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
3' Osasuna take a short corner kick.
2' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. Osasuna win a corner.
1' Juanmi (Getafe) gathers a pass, skips past an opponent and lets fly from mid-range. His effort, however, is well wide of the right post.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are on the pitch and Getafe will have the kick-off.
